g.text: An ongoing eight-week medical-product study guided by Dyutiman Moulik, addressing
moisture damage without exposing sensitive hearing aids to harmful heat.
Battery issues from moisture; earwax and moisture blocking components; static
noise and feedback; malfunction and reduced lifespan; difficult maintenance;
and discomfort during sleep. Sweat, humid weather, leaving an air-conditioned
room and accidental splashes can lead to corrosion and oxidation.
Moisture is a major cause of hearing-aid damage, reducing lifespan and
performance. Existing solutions often fail to remove it safely, reliably and
efficiently. The goal is compact, user-friendly dehumidification without
Hearing aids sit in the ear canal and move through changing climates. Their
sensitive microelectronics face daily condensation, sweat and humidity
Prevent condensation buildup inside a closed drying system
Maintain performance within safe temperature limits at all times
Ensure safe operation under overheating, leaks or saturation
Remove moisture from deep internal regions without damaging sensitive
Integrate dehumidification seamlessly into a daily routine
Make the device portable, intuitive and operable with one hand
Make maintenance effortless and reliable for elderly users
Most products leave relative humidity at 25–30%, while effective deep drying
requires below 10% RH. Unregulated heat risks circuits and batteries, while
generic passive products offer no RH measurement or compliance proof.

Molecular sieves adsorb moisture aggressively even at low humidity, reaching

The system combines a layered copper, polyester and polypropylene Faraday
cage; low-frequency radio waves; channelled airflow; UV-C; a reusable
molecular-sieve 3A cartridge; and a silicone gasket.
Outer body, inner housing, parallel plate for dielectric heating, UV-C, silicone

RF generator at 13.56 MHz → microcontroller → controlled airflow. Power

The resolved product is 80 × 101.4 mm. Its compact footprint brings the drying
chamber, electronics and reusable cartridge into a simple daily-care object.
